receipt_for: fixture determinism only; not a gate measurement
method: two consecutive `prepare` runs in one bench container, same revision, same image, same fixed timestamps
interpretation: the fixture builder is not byte-reproducible across runs: the KV page writer uses Store::create_file, whose ObjectId seed comes from os_random_32, so page ids and every root derived from them differ per run. Within one court run every arm shares one base head (receipt methodology.fixture_heads_seen), so the comparison is sound; cross-run byte identity is not claimed.
